name: agent-panel
description: Live panel of subagents: type, model, effort, tokens, time, memory and the progress of each agent.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew headings and buttons, English row labels)

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: first: open the panel when the first subagent of a session starts; off: only open it with /agent-panel

reportProgress.title: Ask subagents to report progress
reportProgress.description: on: adds one line to each subagent prompt so the panel can show a real percent; off: no prompt change, the row fills by memory use in grey
